evals.prompt: What should I work on in this repo? Build me a prioritized backlog.
evals.expected_output: Runs the multi-phase backlog workflow with parallel discovery, ROI ranking, and a propose gate before any GitHub write.
assertions: Runs parallel discovery (audit-deep, ecosystem-health, repo-state-snapshot) in phase 1
Scores findings with value_score 1 to 5 and ROI = (severity x urgency x value_score) / effort
Dedups against open issues and groups into 3 to 6 themed bundles
Presents findings at an interactive propose gate and makes NO GitHub writes before approval
Ends with a reconciliation block, never silently omitting a skipped phase

evals.prompt: I have 2 days. Prioritize the work with the most value.
evals.expected_output: Applies a time budget to the ranked backlog using a greedy knapsack.
assertions: Honors the time budget (e.g. --budget 2d) via greedy knapsack selection
Shows a Val column with justification per finding
Does not create issues before confirmation

evals.prompt: Create one GitHub issue titled 'Fix typo in README' with the label docs.
evals.expected_output: A single explicit issue, not a repo-wide backlog build.
assertions: Does not run discovery or ROI ranking
Creates just the one requested issue
